categories.description: Shape musical sections, form and arrangement.
Listen, identify, sing and transcribe musical sounds.
Coordinate fingerstyle patterns and thumb independence.
Locate notes, strings and octave relationships on the guitar.
Build, connect and navigate chord structures.
Prepare and handle the instrument comfortably and reliably.
Develop scales, melodic vocabulary and phrasing.
Read guitar tablature and related notation.
Record, review and recover during musical performance.
Learn, retain and perform musical material.
Maintain pulse, subdivide time and shape rhythmic accompaniment.
Develop controlled picking, legato and expressive articulation.

skills.description: Organise musical ideas into sections and shape a coherent arrangement.
Hear, compare and identify the distance or relationship between pitches.
Listen to a melody and work out its notes on the guitar.
Recognise, sing or match a target pitch.
Hear, recall and reproduce rhythmic patterns.
Play and vary repeating fingerstyle picking patterns.
Maintain an independent thumb role while the fingers play other notes.
Locate and name natural notes across guitar strings and positions.
Find octave relationships and use them to navigate the neck.
Relate string names, fret positions and note locations.
Form and move barre-chord shapes with controlled pressure.
Form open-position chords and check their intended notes.
Form movable root-and-fifth power-chord shapes.
Build and play seventh-chord shapes and sounds.
Move between chord shapes smoothly and in time.
Build and navigate three-note chord voicings and inversions.
Connect chords by moving individual notes efficiently.
Use a comfortable, stable guitar position and relaxed playing setup.
Tune the guitar and identify its standard open-string pitches.
Understand and play major-scale patterns and note sequences.
Map and play major or minor pentatonic scale patterns.
Shape short melodic ideas using timing, dynamics, articulation and space.
Interpret string and fret information in guitar tablature.
Capture a performance and use playback to review the result.
Recover from slips or interruptions and continue a musical performance.
Learn, retain and perform songs or other complete musical material.
Control unwanted string noise and use muted sounds or rests intentionally.
Maintain a consistent beat while playing or resting.
Play accompaniment patterns with controlled downstrokes, upstrokes and accents.
Count and perform divisions of the beat with controlled timing.
Coordinate alternating downstrokes and upstrokes.
Bend notes towards an intended pitch with control.
Connect notes using hammer-ons, pull-offs and smooth articulation.
Move the picking hand between strings with control and economy.
